args.title: Clarify local MinIO setup in README
args.body:
File: README.md

Add instructions in the 'Running locally' section to set the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable to the local MinIO URL, preventing uploads from defaulting to AWS and resolving user confusion.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The README.md file's 'Running locally' section is missing instructions to set the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable when using a local MinIO container. This causes uploads to default to AWS, which confused the user. Adding this detail will help clarify the setup for local development.
